messages.text: Did you email the MATC advisor back yet? The placement test slots fill up by April.
Not yet. I keep opening the draft and closing it. I'll do it tonight after dinner I promise.
Okay. Remember three steps we wrote on the index card. Email, FAFSA confirmation, then the campus tour signup. One at a time.
Email is sent. Just having a card to look at helps. Without the bell schedule I lose half the day before I notice.
Honey, the thing on Channel 6 sounded different from what my clinic paper said. Can you look before Sunday dinner?
Yes. I usually check the CDC page and Milwaukee Health Department page first, then I can compare it with your paper.
I got that phone message again and did not touch anything. Can you look after dinner?
Yes. I will bring the little paper where we wrote the steps last time.
Thank you. The pharmacy lady said I could bring the paper in too, but I wanted another set of eyes.
Your Karen does it that way too. One thing at a time, no fuss.
Bring it Sunday. If anything looks confusing, we can ask at the counter instead of guessing from TV.
That works better. I can sit by you and we will go slow.
Can you put the Lakeview Servicing envelope on the kitchen table before you leave? Karen needs the escrow page tonight.
Yeah. Ethan left his algebra folder on top of it, so I'll move both.
Tell him to grab that folder. Bus comes early when the roads are wet.
I put the envelope by your keys and yelled down about the folder.
Can you start the washer before dinner? Work shirts are in the hamper by the basement door.
Yep. I can switch them over after I wipe the counters.
Thanks. Also saw the heel on your black shoes. We can look at them after payday.
They still hold for now. I put cardboard in the back so it does not rub as much.
Talia invited a bunch of people to Colectivo Friday. I can go, but only if you want to.
Could we do lake path after instead, just us? I want to hear what happened with Nia without the whole table jumping in.
Honestly yes. I need someone to help me untangle whether I made it worse.
Send me the order of messages first, then what you meant to say. We can sort it before you answer.
For the MATC checklist tonight, bring your bank routing number, last W-2, and that plain debit card from your wallet.
The voter guide from the neighborhood group came in the mail. I put it by your laptop.
Thanks. I want to compare the school board answers and the county clinic funding question before I fill anything out.
Got them. The section asking for card balances or monthly payments can stay empty, right?
Good. Check the bus route item too, since that affects your ride to MATC.
Yes. Same for the agency letter/case number line unless you have a letter tucked somewhere I haven't seen.
Yeah, I marked the ones who said they would keep the late route and not cut the branch hours.
No letter. I checked the folder with my diploma stuff and it is just taxes, bank papers, and my ID copy.
Are you coming Sunday after church? I am making chicken and potatoes.
Yes. I can bring lemon bars. Could we sit in the dining room instead of near the back door this time?
Of course. Your uncle can keep his after-dinner habit outside.
Thank you. I will bring mint tea too, especially if the card game runs late.
Did you send that bus pass form or do you need me to print it after dinner?
I opened it twice and closed it. My chest got tight when it asked me to choose the pickup option.
Pick the nearest one. We can fix it later if needed.
Okay. I'm doing just the first page now, then the address box after dishes.
Do you still want Stone Creek before we go look for the watercolor book?
Yes. I saved the library hold notice because I knew you'd remember the exact shelf better than me.
Only because you still tease me about labeling every brush in Salazar's room.
That system worked. Meet you by the side entrance at 5:30.
If you take the lake route before breakfast, text me when you're back.
Leaving now. Shoes were by the door already.
Fog near Lincoln Memorial Drive this morning, so use the crossings.
Back. The house is still mostly asleep.
Did you see the post for the church fish fry? Your aunt said it was on that family page.
I found it on FB. I don't check there much except family stuff and the neighborhood page.
Good. I only need the time, not all the chatter.
It's 5:30. I'll text Mom too instead of putting anything under the post.
I can swing by after work. Do you want the lake perch place or the one by 76th?
76th if the line isn't out the door. Can we get an extra little bag of curds for Ethan?
Need a ride to Mitchell Street after dinner or are you taking the bus?
Fine. First pitch is 7:10 so I don't want to wait forever.
Bus there, maybe ride home if it runs late. I told them I could get the folding tables up before people arrive.
I'll be ready when you pull up. We can put the radio on in the car.
Text me when you are done. Do not carry those supply boxes alone.
I won't. Mostly tape, markers, the sign-in pages, and snack trays tonight.
I put the clean towels on your bed. Ethan is still loud downstairs, so close your door if you need the desk for a while.
Thanks. I have my notebook and the drawing pencils out already.
Good. I will remind him to lower the game volume after dishes.
That helps. I am putting on the soft playlist and doing a few pages before I read.
Could you come by Tuesday before lunch and look at my phone again?
Yes, Tuesday morning is open. I just have the library printer stop after.
Bring those papers your mother mentioned. I have stamps if any have to be mailed.
Thanks. It is mostly the page with empty tax-form boxes and the March statement.
Are you still coming by after lunch tomorrow?
Yes, Mom said around 1:30. I can bring the end pieces from the pan with the rosemary and thyme on top.
That sounds good. Put them in foil so they do not dry out.
I will. I kept a little container aside for you before Ethan got to it.
Before you send that form, did you total books, bus, and the lab fee too?
Yes. I made a column for every fee I could find. The program with unpaid mornings came off the list.
Good. Ask them plain if hours change week to week.
I put that in the email. I also asked if the intake desk role is mostly patient check-in and records instead of pushing upgrades.
Shop said the tire sensor might run close to $400 if they replace the whole thing. Want me to look at it first?
Please. I can cover some, but that number would take a big bite out of what I set aside for school.
I'll check it after lunch. Don't pay them yet.
Thanks. If it really is that much I may need to talk with you and Mom before I swipe anything.
Are you taking the blue mat or is it still by the hallway closet?
Taking it after lunch. The rec place only charges a few dollars if I make the 1:30 class.
Ok. Move it before Dad trips on it again lol.
Do you want me to save you two eggs for after dinner?
Yes please. I can bring the little loaf I made yesterday too.
Good. I have vegetable soup on, so that will make enough.
Perfect. I was going to pass the diner and just come straight over.
Your mom said you are looking at those classes by the big campus. Do they have anything where you can still be around books?
A little. One track has circulation desk practice, another has family center placement hours. I wrote down both.
Bring the paper Sunday and I will save you a piece of cake. I want to see the one with the children too.
Okay. I also need to fix my sample visit note before I show Mom.
Honey, if you are coming Sunday, can you look at my phone? It keeps showing that same odd notice.
Yes. I put a buzz on my phone for 4:20, and I wrote it on the right page of my little blue book too.
Good. Bring that book if you need quiet time after dinner.
I might. I have the bus times and one school email draft tucked in there.
Counts are gonna be rough this week. Gonna swap the furnace filter today.
yeah I sneezed like 10 times before coffee 🙃
Pulling the MERV 13 from the basement. You okay on tissues?
nope, finished the box in my room. will grab more after class
Need a ride after your place on Lincoln or taking the bus?
Bus there, maybe ride back if the floors take longer. They put me on the back row today.
Text when you are done. Keep the old shoes in the porch if they get bleachy.
Okay. I have to refill the small bowls first anyway, so probably close to 5.
When you ask the advisor today, check whether the dental office shadow form can wait until fall.
I wrote that down. If the downtown campus works, I can keep taking the same bus route from home.
Good. And for spring break, Lake Park and the art museum free day sound easier than that Chicago hotel idea.
Yes. I would rather pack lunch and use the pass than spend two paychecks on one weekend.
Can you ask your mom if she still knows my Tuesday time with Dr. Sato? I wrote 1:10 but my paper looks smudged.
She said she can check the book when the morning rush slows down.
Thank you. And tell your dad the hallway vent is quiet now after what he did Sunday.
I will. Mom also said bring the coupon from the fridge if you want the cheaper toothpaste pack.
Honey, can you remind me which place I go to in April? The school gym or the church basement?
I can look yours up after dinner. I already checked mine and saved the address so I don't get turned around.
Thank you. I want to read the parts about the bus stop changes and the library hours before I fill anything out.
Same. I skipped the loud TV panel this morning and just read the city page. Easier to actually understand.
I posted the library panel flyer. They added a quiet room this time, so it might be less packed.
That helps. I want to hear the part about apartment applications and school funding, but standing in a packed room makes my chest do that tight thing.
We can sit near the side door or just stream it at my place with coffee.
Streaming may be better. I still want notes from the Q&A, especially if they talk about giving people a real starting line.
Still meeting by the lake or do you want the branch with the big windows?
Branch, if that's okay. I want twenty quiet minutes before talking.
Works for me. I'll bring coffee and sit near the new-arrivals wall.
Perfect. I have to grab the French one from the hold shelf anyway.
Are you still awake? My controller is in the kitchen somewhere.
Yeah but my phone's already plugged in out there, so look by the toaster.
Found it. Why is your phone way over here?
Because I opened IG for two minutes and ended up staring at dorm photos from people at school. Kitchen charger wins.
Mom said your bank app is still open on the family laptop
Can you close it? I was checking if the $62 went in before I write the school number in my notebook.
Closed. Also your notebook says 348 with a circle around it?
Yeah, leave it there please. I need to update it after dinner.
Dr. Nguyen's office called back. They said the Saturday appointment is fine as long as you bring the old card.
Okay. I already saved the CDC timing chart so I can make sure I wrote the date right.
Good. The pharmacist can check it too when we pick up toothpaste after.
That works. I would rather have them look than go by random comments.
Mrs. Cardenas asked if you wanted to come to the church game night with us Saturday. It may be a full room.
I think I'll pass on the game night. Can I help you set up the dessert table earlier and then head home?
That works. Thank you for offering. Also Maya texted me that you helped her think through that friend thing.
She was upset, so I just wrote the pieces down with her. I'll put the lemon bars in the carrier Friday night.
Sweetheart, I dug out Oma Reeves's kuchen recipe finally. The one with the streusel on top.
oh my gosh yes please send a photo. is that the one Opa always asked for on Christmas Eve?
That's the one. His mother brought it from Bremen. I'll have you copy it Sunday so we can do it for Easter.
perfect. I'll bring the index cards. love you grandma
I may go to that big downtown thing Saturday. You coming or staying with your Mitchell Street crew?
Probably Mitchell Street. They asked me to sit at the first table and explain the pantry cards without making anyone feel rushed.
That sounds like you. I can send you the flyer anyway.
Send it. I still want to read it, I just promised Mrs. Alvarez I would be there by 9.
Are you still up for coffee after the library, or did the kitchen project win?
Coffee works. I have two focaccia squares wrapped for you if you want them.
Absolutely. The one with the little green bits last time was so good.
Same pots on the sill. I clipped rosemary and thyme before the dough went in.
I saw your sticker pic. You actually went early?
Yeah, before I could overthink it. I skipped the loud mailers and used the answers about buses, school lunches, and book challenges.
That sounds like you. I was checking who backed the community clinic thing too.
Same. I do not agree with every line on the slate, but those parts mattered more.
Are you with Maya after dinner or heading straight home?
With Maya. We're just walking near the lake path for a little bit.
Okay. Take the brighter route back and text me when you leave her.
I will. She also found the picture of my first lopsided vase from school and won't stop laughing.
If you come Sunday, could you bring those clean dish towels your mother mentioned?
Yes, I am folding them with the kitchen towels tonight.
Good. And do not walk all over the fairgrounds in those thin shoes, honey.
I know. I will wear thicker socks and keep it short if we go.
Your mom said you looked at that office job near the bus stop. Is it the one by the clinic?
Yes. It pays less than the phone sales place, but the listing says 8:00 to 4:30 and helping people sign in.
Being able to get home for dinner matters too.
That was on my notes. I do not want to chase a bigger check if it means different evenings every week.
Before you send that school form, make sure you did not list me or your mom as someone you owe for the bus pass or shoes.
I left that part blank. You both said those were just family help, not something I am paying back.
Good. Also if it asks for county worker name or letter date, do not invent one. Blank is better than guessing.
I put blanks there too and saved the draft for Mom to look over after dinner.
Mrs. Alvarez asked if you were still stopping by tomorrow with those papers.
Yes, after groceries. I sorted them into rent, clinic, and school folders so it is not a pile.
Good. Your mom said bring the clear folder, not the bent blue one.
Got it. I will write the phone numbers big at the top like she showed me.
Did the college office ask for anything else?
They want the last 12-month activity line checked. I counted it out and wrote 0.
Okay. Keep the bank printout with it so nobody sends it back.
I put March 1-13 with it. Nothing extra came in besides family transfers.
Library first or coffee first tomorrow?
Library first. I am bringing yogurt with berries, so maybe we can sit by the windows instead.
Works for me. I can make tea at home before I leave.
Thanks. I still want the walk after, just skipping the counter this time.
Coffee tomorrow still okay? I found a tiny table near the back window at Anodyne last time.
Yes. Tonight I am staying in with the lamp, my blue notebook, and that Adrianne Lenker mix you sent.
That mix is perfect for low-volume room time. Bring the little flower sketch tomorrow if you want.
I might. I need to get the messy stuff out on paper first.
Coffee first or that stretch by Bradford while the sky is still pale?
Bradford first. I brought the old sneakers in my tote.
Meet by the stairs at 7:20 then. I can bring your library book too.
Perfect. I like doing that part before the lamps get too bright.
Jules changed the plan to that apartment thing after coffee. I think people are bringing gummies and little tins.
I will do coffee and the walk, then head home before the apartment part.
That works. I can leave with you and we can take the lake path.
Thanks. I packed ginger candies and my sketchbook, so that is enough for me.
Did you print that chart thing? Dad said the printer is making lines again.
Not yet. I need the columns to stop moving before I print it.
Is it for school stuff or the place where you helped with sign-in?
Both kind of. It has bus times, application dates, and which places ask for a written summary after each appointment.
Are you using the kitchen table forever? I need room for my history poster.
Ten more minutes. I have three tabs open and the notebook has sticky flags everywhere.
Mom said don't lose the paper with the times on it.
I copied them already. One is the campus bus, one is the money page, and one is that part-time posting by the library.
I can swing by after my 9:30 appointment. Same front steps as when you were little?
Yes. I packed the tote already and put our returns by the door.
For that volunteer form, the line about courthouse history is probably just a background question. Do you need dates from us?
Good. We can do your holds first, then groceries before the crowds.
It asks about me and people in our house. I can only think of Dad's old speeding ticket and my library fine, which definitely does not count.
Right. Nothing beyond traffic stuff for us. If they need exact wording, bring the form home and we will read it together.
Can we sit a little after? The corner by the magazines is usually empty.
Thanks. I was more sure about the short-answer part on fair treatment than this paperwork section.
When you get back from the library, can you check if Mark left the water bill under the Lakeview statement?
Sure. Ethan texted me that he needs the Chromebook charger too, so I'll look in the front room.
Thank you. His permission slip is on the fridge if you see him before I do.
Found the charger. I'll leave the statement where you and Mark can see it.
Are you still coming for dinner tomorrow or do you have that Saturday place?
I have the noon slot today, not tomorrow. After I help in the cat room I can still bake tonight.
Wash up good before you start with flour. Those little ones climb all over.
Honey did you see my phone message from the clinic? I don't know if I tapped the wrong thing.
I saw it. Sorry I went quiet yesterday, I kept meaning to answer and then kept putting the phone face down.
That's alright. Just tell me one thing to press when you come by.
Deal. First I'll check the blue message, then we'll write the appointment time on your fridge card.
If you and your mom go past Miller Park Way, grab the thermostat batteries. Two-pack is fine.
Okay. Mom is waiting on the first patient forms to finish printing before we leave.
No rush. I have a no-heat call at the apartments after lunch.
She says we have a $3 hardware coupon, so I will use that.
Lake path later or are you doing the slow room-B thing first?
Room B first if the bus lines up. It is mostly breathing and holding poses, so I will still be fine for a short walk.
Perfect. Coffee after the walk if you are not too sleepy.
Yes, but cheap coffee. I already have the $3 for the front desk.
The fair posted dates again. Same one near West Allis, first Saturday in August.
I still remember the cream puff line from when I was little. We can go early and skip parking by taking the bus.
That works. I will bake the night before if your mother can drive me there.
Put me down for helping. I should still be here for August classes anyway.
How was the tour? Did you actually go to the financial aid desk this time or did you spiral in the parking lot lol
I went. Mom came in with me. They gave me a placement test date for April 9. It felt good having a thing on the calendar honestly.
Dude same. June through now has been the weirdest stretch of my life. Nobody telling you when to be anywhere is wild.

Right? My friend from biology jumped straight into Amazon warehouse and another did the whole nothing-til-fall thing. Neither felt right. Two classes plus working at the library felt like the only version of me that could function.
Saw the notice on the fridge. Do you need a ride to the municipal building on the 25th or are you taking the 22?
The 22 should work if it stays on time. I'm going after work to ask about the early paperwork and the route proposal.
Text me if the bus runs late. Those route changes matter for you and Mom getting around.
I will. I'm keeping it to city stuff today, no all-day yelling shows in the background.
happy st patricks!! you wearing the green pin from your grandpa again?
ha yes, mom made me. she pulled out the old Kelly family album too, the one from when great grandma came over from Cork
okay that's actually so cute. my mom never does that stuff with me lol
mom and grandma are like obsessed with it. dad just rolls his eyes and asks if there's corned beef
Aunt Denise asked if you could share the bake sale flyer where Grandma will see it.
I can put it in the FB family group. I'll send you the IG version too because that's the one I actually keep open.
That works. If anyone asks about rides or money, send them to me in a message.
Yep. I don't want that in comments. I'll keep the post just flyer and time.
Are you girls still thinking about the fair booth in June? I found my old folding table cover.
Yes, Mom said we can help if it lines up. I mostly want the lemonade and those squeaky curds again.
Your grandpa always had the ballgame in one ear out there. Bring your little radio if you have it.
I still have the blue one. I'll check the batteries before then.
Sweetheart, the form at the senior center asks for your age for the volunteer roster. What do I put?
Nineteen, Grandma. Same as last time you asked :)
Oh good, then they said the under-21 box for the liability slip. Mom said your birthday is coming up in April. I will put a card in the mail.
Thanks Grandma. Sunday dinner still on? I can bring the lemon bars.
Can you run the dishwasher and sweep before I get home? I have late patients on the schedule.
I can do both before the bus.
Also, Kohl's has plain black sneakers on sale until Saturday. Just tell me if you want to stop.
Maybe Saturday. I do not want to make the list bigger this week.
Before your advisor email, write down what you can add from the next two paychecks.
If both hit the way I think, I can add about $180 this month. Still not near the $1,000 line.
One step at a time. Keep gas and bus money separate, and we can talk if something big comes up.
Okay. I just don't want a random bill to erase the school pile.
You still going to that meeting after work? I can pick you up if the bus is late.
Yes, it is the county one about clinic fees and the route cuts. I only signed up for a 2 minute comment.
Text me when it ends. Parking over there is annoying.
I will. I am wearing the little pin from the school board table so the organizer can find me.
Your mother said the cousins may stop by tonight. I can pick up extra chairs if needed.
If everyone comes, I might eat early and help clean after. I can still make the grocery list before they get here.
That is fine. Text me the list by noon and I'll get what is cheapest.
I'll send it in sections: dinner, Grandma's stuff, and Ethan's snacks. Also Maya may call after work about what to say to her coworker.
I saw the bus pass charge cleared. Need anything from Pick 'n Save?
Just oats, eggs, and a bag of apples if they are still on sale.
No takeout tonight then?
No, I have soup left and can roast the sweet potatoes.
Coffee after library? I can cover today if you are waiting on your paycheck.
I am okay. I have $14 on my debit and no monthly payment coming out before Friday.
Nice. Did the campus form still want that agency-letter thing?
Yes, but the advisor said blank is fine when there is nothing to attach.
lake walk tomorrow morning? trail by Bradford should be clear
ughhh can we push it a week? head's been pounding since I woke up and my eyes are watering
oh no. Tylenol?
took 2 like an hour ago, helping a little. counts were 9.2 yesterday lol
yeah I felt it on my walk yesterday. let's do next Sat instead 💛
Mom said you need me to sign that youth center sheet?
Only the part saying nobody at home has had a serious court thing. I already checked with Mom.
lol my worst thing is Mr. Keane writing me up for headphones.
That does not count. I am trying to finish before the workshop on school discipline and second chances.
Maya left her scarf on the chair. Again.
Can you put it by my bag? We're stopping at the library before I give it back.
The one with paint dots? Looks like it survived forever.
Yeah, that one. It has been around since the clay tables.
Can u ask Karen if she saw my student ID? Need it for Monday.
It's on the microwave by Mark's tape measure. Also please bring the trash bins up before dinner.
Ok. Is the big Lakeview thing still on the table or can I put my notebook there?
Leave that stack alone until Karen signs the last page.
Mom asked if you answered Maya about coffee tomorrow
Not yet. I typed "sure" and then changed it like six times because it sounded weird.
Just send sure lol
I'm sending one sentence, then putting the phone on the dresser so I stop checking it.
Can you pick me up from Leo's? His older cousin is being weird and the garage smells awful.
Tell Dad I am going with him. Wait by the front steps, not in the garage.
Ok. Are you mad
No, I just do not want either of us around that. Grab your backpack and we will get fries on the way home.
I put the Aldi list on the counter. Please check the sale tags before adding cereal.
Got it. Are you still done at 5:15?
Maybe 5:25. Dr. Sato squeezed in the little boy who cracked a filling, so I am moving two reminder calls.
Dad texted that he can meet us after the boiler room check if the van starts acting up again.
I put the MATC envelope on the kitchen table. The advisor circled three codes and wrote that the writing sample can be short.
Thanks. I keep mixing up which one has the school placement and which one has the resource-desk hours.
Use one page for each code. List hours, bus route, cost, and what paperwork they expect.
I can do that in Excel tonight and add the note sample under each one.
I can drop you near the clinic before I go look at that furnace. What time do they want you there?
1:40. They said to wait there 15 minutes after, so maybe pick me up closer to 2:10?
Fine. Did you check if insurance covers it there or at the pharmacy?
Yes, the portal note matched what the pharmacist told me. No copay listed.
The table felt calmer once you moved the extra chair beside yours.
People talk more when they are not standing in line with everyone watching.
Also the numbered sticky notes were smart. Very Karen-coded.
She would say snacks, clear steps, and a backup pen solve half the problem.
Dad says the game is already on. Are you bringing those curd things from Grandma's or no
There's half a container in the fridge. Save me some and don't blast your headset during dinner.
Ok. Also Mom said church people dropped off extra rolls if you want one.
Yes please. I'll be back before the middle innings if the bus is normal.
Pastor H is doing the early service for Palm Sunday next week. We'll go to the 8am so grandma's home before her show.
ok. do I need to do anything for it?
Just wear something nice. We're not staying for coffee hour, dad has the Brewers game on at 1.
got it. corned beef Saturday at grandma's still?
Yes, with the kuchen she's teaching you. Bring an apron
ok so the apartment listing wants 'household income' and i don't even know what to put. it's just me.
lol same energy. mine would be 'me + mom + dad + ethan'. still in my bedroom from middle school
honestly that's the only reason i can even consider this. no rent at your folks place is a huge head start
yeah. no kids no partner no lease, just me and the community college forms. one thing at a time
Mom said are you eating here or at that hall thing
Here if the supply closet list is quick. I have to sort paper plates from cleaning stuff and leave the March totals in the binder.
Can you bring home one of those cookies if there are extras
Maybe. Also remind Dad I may need a pickup if the last family has questions again.
where r the tissues
bathroom cabinet, left side. behind the mouthwash
ur the one who used them all tho
😤 march has been brutal. grab me the box too, my room
Can you use headphones for the next half hour? I am at my desk with my notebook.
Yeah sorry. Ranked match is over in like 2 min.
Thanks. I have the quiet guitar songs on but the wall still shakes when you yell.
Headphones on. Also Mom said dinner leftovers are in the square container.
Can you do Grandma's groceries around 2:00, or do you need me to move it?
2:00 is fine. I only have the advisor email and the bus ride today.
Good. Did you attach the March page with no outside deposits?
Yes, plus the signed page that says 0 for the last year section.
FAFSA email came. They want your dependency status confirmed. Says parents' info required because you are under 24 and unmarried with no dependents.
ok yeah, all of that is still true lol. just me on the form.
Good. I will put your DOB on the worksheet so we have it together for the advisor. Same address as ours of course.
thanks mom. Saturday library to finish it?
I sent you that mug painting reel. IG, not TikTok, because I know which one you'll actually see.
Saw it. I saved it before the 10:30 charger rule catches me.
Good. Also don't read the replies on Janelle's campus post tonight.
I won't. If I'm weird about it tomorrow I'll text you, not post a whole paragraph.
Can I eat the bread on the counter or is that for you
You can have one slice. Leave me two for egg toast later.
Mom said she might grab burgers after your errand.
Tell her I am good with what is here. I put soup in the front of the fridge.
Dad said don't touch the hallway panel, he left it open because the upstairs unit was short cycling.
Okay. Mom still at the desk?
Yeah she called and said two people swapped times so dinner is 6:45.
Then keep the leftovers covered. She said no ordering pizza when there is food already made.
Mom said dinner in 20 and asked if the trash is out.
Trash is out. I am putting away the groceries now.
Your shoe lace thing is on the floor by the couch again.
Leave it there please. I need it for the loose side tomorrow.
Dad said you picked the boring office thing lol
It is not boring to know the hours before Monday and not have to sell people stuff they did not ask for.
Fair. Does it still let you do your school thing?
Yes, if I use the monthly plan and keep Tuesdays open for class. I wrote the first two due dates on the fridge.
Can you tell Mom I'm done with dishes? Also are Maya and those art people coming over?
Just Maya tomorrow for an hour. I told the others maybe another time.
Good because I need the table for homework. Are you doing the thing where you make columns for her drama?
Probably. I printed two blank pages so she can put facts on one side and guesses on the other.
Before I leave for work, did you decide whether to call admissions or email them?
I froze on that. Calling feels like too much, but email feels like I'll miss something and bother them twice.
Then write two lines first. You don't have to solve the whole thing at 7:30.
Two lines, then breakfast, then I'll add just the student ID before sending.
Long day. Do you want me to make chamomile or just leave the kettle out?
Kettle is good. I am going to shower, fold towels, and sit with my notebook.
I moved your dad's garage jacket to the basement so the kitchen does not smell.

events.title: Oak Leaf loop before bus
events.notes: Thermos, gray hoodie, back before breakfast.

events.title: Advisor call - aid worksheet
events.notes: Ask about leaving the W-2/1099 boxes empty; print March bank page if needed.

events.title: Mitchell Street hall dinner prep
events.notes: Bring blue tape, name tags, 2 clipboards. Put sign-in near west doors. Ask Mrs. Alvarez about receipts before buying cups.

events.title: Soup pot + roast tray
events.notes: Use carrots, onion, potatoes, and the last yogurt cups. Portion lunches for Wednesday and Thursday; no campus cafe stop.

events.title: Mat room drop-in
events.location: Mitchell Park rec building, Room B
events.notes: $3 at front desk; bring old blue mat

events.title: Starter refresh + trim pots
events.notes: Set aside small bundle of rosemary and thyme before mixing. If the loaf cools in time, wrap a few slices for Linda.

events.title: Compare MATC packet + clinic office posting
events.notes: Bring folder: FAFSA email, bus pass cost, $35 application fee, immunization record. Posting notes: Tue-Sat 8-4, same desk most days, no sales calls. Write questions before emailing Ms. Nolan.

events.title: Walgreens — quick stop
events.notes: tissues (big box), generic 24hr tabs, eye drops, Tylenol 8ct — ~$14 total

events.title: Blue notebook: MATC tab + Route 18
events.notes: Phone alert: copy two dates from the program page, star one aid link, write one question for admissions inbox.

events.title: School money check
events.notes: Count cash envelope + app balance. Add Friday deposit if it clears. Keep $1,000 line for before classes.

events.title: Desk pages + sketchbook
events.notes: Lamp, blue notebook, library book, soft guitar playlist.

events.title: Phone on kitchen charger
events.notes: Save Aunt Carol's FB rummage post for morning. Check IG recipe folder before charger. Skip TikTok after.

events.title: MATC program Zoom: ECE / HMSV / library tech options
events.notes: Ask about fall start, practicum hours, and whether the spreadsheet basics workshop counts before placement forms.

events.title: Northside evening shift
events.notes: Closed shoes. Sign in at front desk. Start with bowls and water bottles, then Room B mop bucket. Ask Toni before opening back gate.

events.title: Pick up Mom, then Menards stop
events.notes: Mom closing late after Dr. Sato's 4:40 got moved. Dad wants 16x25 filters if rebate card is still in glove box.

events.title: Check MyVote page + sample ballot
events.notes: Confirm ward place, April 7 hours, and which rows mention buses, library board, school items, county clinic funding. No cable clips while doing this.

events.title: MATC info table + bus pass desk
events.location: MATC Downtown Milwaukee Campus, 700 W State St
events.notes: Ask about fall classes and the 2028 transfer sheet. Bring M-Card. Stop by Central Library after if the 31 is on time.

events.title: Watch City Hall stream
events.notes: Agenda tabs saved: tenant screening rules, school boundary comments, public safety board testimony. Use headphones at home instead of going downtown.

events.title: Walgreens counter - bring card
events.notes: Ask pharmacist which March dose timing matches Dr. Nguyen's portal note. Check Milwaukee Health Dept page before leaving.

events.title: Atkinson branch with Mom
events.notes: Pick up holds under D. Reeves; check the far table before errands.

events.title: Early vote stop + branch budget cards
events.notes: Bring ID. Drop comment card about evening hours, teen tutoring room, Route 54 stop, and county clinic copay question.

events.title: Maya - coffee, hold pickup, lake if clear
events.location: Colectivo Coffee on Prospect Ave; Milwaukee Public Library East Branch
events.notes: Bring tote bag and the old gray sketchbook Maya asked about.

events.title: Library table setup
events.notes: Bring sign-in sheet, extra pens from Karen, tea bags, and the small step card. Keep two chairs open for anyone who needs help filling forms.

events.title: Basement laundry, bathroom, entry rug
events.notes: Before Sunday dinner. Check black flats by door; use inserts if walking to Grandma Linda's.

events.title: Service at Mt. Olive on Wisconsin Ave
events.notes: Pastor Hannemann doing the Lent service. Grandma Linda meeting us out front at 10:15. Bring the offering envelope mom set on the counter.

events.title: Maya - lake loop + coffee
events.location: Lakefront trail near Bradford Beach; Rochambo Coffee after
events.notes: Pick the side table if open. Bring sketchbook. Ask about Nia message chain before she replies. Leave by 4:45 for dinner at home.

events.title: Sunday dinner at Grandma Linda's
events.notes: Bring lemon bars and mint tea. Sit in dining room. Walk home with Karen if the porch gets crowded.

events.title: Advisor email block
events.notes: Open draft. Delete extra paragraph. Ask only one question about placement test date. Send before re-reading more than twice.

events.title: MATC aid desk - bring tax folder
events.location: MATC Downtown Milwaukee Campus, S Building
events.notes: Pack ID, W-2, bank printout. Ask advisor whether blank balance/payment rows and blank case-number row are okay before submitting.

events.title: Sign Lakeview packet with Karen + Mark
events.notes: After Ethan finishes biology worksheet. Put stamped envelope by front door for Tuesday mail.

events.title: MATC campus tour - Downtown
events.notes: Bring ID and the printed FAFSA confirmation. Advisor desk is on the second floor. Check the financial aid handout pickup before leaving.

events.title: DMV - REAL ID upgrade, bring birth cert + proof of MKE address
events.notes: Mom is driving. Bring birth certificate (04/18/2007), Social Security card, two pieces of mail to Reeves household address. Karen has the folder.

events.title: St. Anne dinner + game on WTMJ
events.notes: Bring cash for plates. Ask if they still have curds. Head home before late innings.

events.title: Library w/ mom
events.notes: bring tissues + water bottle. mom wants the financial aid printout

events.title: Financial aid desk - document drop
events.notes: Bring signed 12-month sheet, March bank printout, and ID. Ask if 0 entry needs initials.

events.title: Blue notebook / book chapter
events.notes: Charge earbuds first. Big Thief queue. Finish library chapter after two pages.

events.title: Roll dough before bus
events.notes: Cinnamon filling, second rise after school. Water rosemary and thyme pots while the bowl rests.

events.title: Call admissions before work
events.notes: Ask Ms. Nolan: final out-of-pocket amount after aid, payment-plan dates, refund deadline, whether externship shifts are assigned in advance. Keep notes in blue folder.

events.title: Send note before work: advisor question
events.notes: Use draft from notebook. Ask about April 1 form date and whether the aid checklist opens after account setup.

events.title: Thursday help desk + rooms
events.notes: Wear badge. Check latch chart before dog runs. Fresh water after dinner trays. Sit with shy gray tabby only after Toni okays it.

events.title: Breathing + floor class
events.notes: Bus 31 there; skip if shoes still wet

events.title: Saturday pantry morning
events.notes: Arrive early for chairs and taped arrows. Count coffee, cups, cereal, and bus passes. Add $34.80 Aldi receipt to March sheet.

events.title: Central stop: returns + reading table
events.notes: Due today: Patchett. Pick up Locke hold. Sit upstairs if the first floor is busy.

events.title: South shore loop
events.notes: Bring lighter jacket; avoid the construction by the tennis courts.

events.title: Library, lake walk, $6 coffee
events.location: Milwaukee Public Library East Branch; Bradford Beach path
events.notes: Check out MATC folder copies. Bring thermos if the cafe line is long. No rideshare unless it rains.

events.title: Call advisor - Ms. Hollis - reg holds + 2 classes fall
events.notes: Fall plan: Eng 195 + Intro Psych, keep it to two so the day still has a shape. Ask about library work-study posting. Need ID number from the acceptance email before calling.

events.title: Candidate Q&A watch w/ Maya
events.notes: Bring cookies. Compare notes on branch funding, MCTS passes, school counselor staffing, clinic fee cap, and the housing voucher answer.

events.title: Update health card photo
events.notes: Upload front/back to patient portal. Check Dr. Nguyen message and CDC page for next-date spacing before filing paper copy.

events.title: Municipal building stop
events.location: Milwaukee Municipal Building, 200 E Wells St
events.notes: Bring ID and address note. Ask clerk desk about April 7 early form. Pick up handouts on transit proposal, school board names, library hours, and county counseling clinic line item.

events.title: Drop Lakeview check in blue mailbox
events.location: Corner of S 13th St and W Lincoln Ave
events.notes: Mark wrote it before work. Karen said mail it after Ethan leaves for first bell.

events.title: Upload MATC packet
events.notes: Final check: W-2 uploaded, bank PDF uploaded, ID uploaded. Rows for monthly balances, family repayment, case number, and agency letter left blank per advisor.

events.title: Grandma Linda's - kuchen + corned beef prep
events.notes: Bring index cards for the Bremen kuchen recipe. Mom wants to do a photo with the old Kelly album for Easter. Dad picking us up at 3 so he's home before the game.

events.title: Summerfest volunteer signup walk-through
events.location: Henry Maier Festival Park gate office
events.notes: Check bus back before evening. Maybe stop near Brady for a basket to split. Keep phone charged for score alerts.

events.title: My 20th - dinner at home w/ Mom, Dad, Ethan, Grandma Linda
events.notes: Mom is making the roast. Maya is coming after work. No big party, just family. Update license photo since the new one will say 20 now.
